caption: The drawing depicts a single, light greenish-blue glass bottle positioned vertically at the center of a blank, beige background. The bottle is pear-shaped with a long neck and a flared rim at the top. Its surface features embossed decorative elements, including a raised emblem in the form of a sheaf of wheat and branches with leaves near the upper body of the bottle. The bottle shows highlights and shaded areas suggesting reflections and transparency characteristic of glass. The artist’s signature, “CLAUDE H. MARSHALL,” is written in small, capital letters in the lower right corner of the image. There are a few small brown spots scattered above the bottle, and the rest of the background is unadorned.
title: Glass Bottle
